description: L6 closure-theorem reachability: fraction of d-block complexes whose SMILES survives the closure pipeline end-to-end (parse -> dative '<-' rewrite -> closure -> product enumeration). Wf-67 Phase 2 R20 benchmark on the real tmQM d-block subset.
raw_artifact_note: The raw report lives under molmetal/reports/**, which .gitignore:145 ignores (`molmetal/reports/**/*.json`). This file exists so the paper-line L6 number has a tracked source; the raw artifact is the reproducible input, not the citation point.
protocol: max_depth=1, max_products=64, seeds=1, CPU-only closure-theorem end-to-end
honest_framing: MEASURED_BELOW_GATE — 2981/5000 complexes reach closure (0.5962) against a 0.95 gate; 1 of 30 metals passes. Smiles preprocessor rewrites dative '<-' to covalent '-' before parsing, so the rate is a property of the closure pipeline on this cohort, not of the underlying chemistry alone. CPU-only; no GPU work.
